proposal.summary: Dana's absence removes J5, J6 and J7. J5 goes to Aisha Khan as a delay to 12:19, which pushes her toilet repair J12 to 16:00 and needs dispatcher approval. J6 goes to Marcus Hale and J7 to Priya Nair in their existing slots.
assumptions: Aisha Khan finishes J11 at 12:15 at 31 Birch Ave and can leave immediately, so J5 starts 12:19 (4 min travel).
J12 (toilet repair, flexible urgency) can be moved to 16:00-17:00 with approval and the customer's consent.
Taking J6 and J7 does not conflict with any other job in each technician's schedule.

side_effects.reason: Displaced to make room for J5 delay; needs approval (displace_job) and customer contact. Travel J5 to J12 is 40 min, so 15:19 end plus 40 min gives 15:59, rounded to 16:00 start.

jobs.rationale: Aisha Khan is the only Plumbing and Gas certified technician, and she is free at 12:15 nearby, so the highest-revenue urgent job is covered first via a delay of 79 minutes, within the 240-minute standard limit. Doing so requires displacing J12, which is flexible, to 16:00-17:00.

alternatives.tradeoff: Keeps J12 at 15:00 but leaves a $1850 same-day water heater job uncovered for an elderly customer with no hot water.

jobs.rationale: Marcus Hale is free after J1 ends at 14:00 and reaches 77 Pine Row in 4 minutes, so the 14:30 slot is kept with no revenue at risk. Tiebreak over Priya Nair goes to proximity (4 min vs 24 min).

Priya Nair is free after J3 ends at 13:00 and reaches 5 Willow Way in 28 minutes, so the 15:45 slot is kept with no revenue at risk. Marcus Hale can only serve it with a delay because of his J6 travel.
